generation.scope: On the finite-four-edge locus with a maximal tangent point and a quantum polynomial ternary base, there are exactly two base types. Each gives an irreducible six-dimensional family of indexed classes. Nine explicit coefficients, row and vertex tests, torus weights and finite permutations decide every exceptional case, local length and period. Generic minimal periods are two and four. All nine-parameter presentations, including positive-dimensional edge specializations, are standard AS.

open_mathematics: For a ternary AS3 base with smooth elliptic point graph evaluate the Ore recurrence at a triple of consecutive points. Compare the two contraction planes using the ternary potential and test the resulting fourth-power obstruction. Determine the section versus gauge quotient, admissible shift and normal forms. Retain embedding-dimension-two and unrestricted windows, and the ordinary rank-15 four-cut rank locus, as separate open tasks.
